ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the perimeter and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit a contiguous light-grey to white pigmentation. Darker, low-intensity pixel clusters form a thick border along the trailing edge. Distinct, dark vertical linear formations (5-6 counts) originate from the upper right lobe's trailing edge, extending downward toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 50 degrees, bisecting the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern observed. Peaks and valleys vary in amplitude (2-8 pixels) along the continuous boundary from the notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on both the left and right lobes as they extend from the median notch to the outer terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5 parallel, vertical dark-pixel linear disruptions located on the medial region of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serration/chipping on the trailing edge suggests mechanical trauma; a brownish biological or inorganic mass is attached to the far-left terminal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'drip' or 'tentacle' pigmentation pattern consisting of dark vertical lines on the right ventral lobe.
